model: BPE, byte-level (full 256-symbol initial alphabet), trained from scratch

policies.document_boundary: EOT id appended exactly once after every document; no BOS
policies.literal_special_text: raw text containing the EOT spelling is encoded as ordinary bytes (tokenizers encode_special_tokens=True, set by gibc.tokenizer.load_tokenizer; not persisted in tokenizer.json)
policies.pad: no PAD token; if batched evaluation needs a pad id, reuse the EOT id with padded positions masked; add a dedicated PAD (inside the 24,000) only if that proves insufficient
